about.headerTitle: Jo-Kenya ema ogero, ne jotelo mag Kenya
about.storyP1: Kampen mag Kenya kawuono itiyo gi rieko kod weche mowuok kuom jong'ad bura.
about.storyP2: Joma olocho kod joma olal kinde mang'eny ing'ado bura kuom hawi, to ok rieko.
about.storyP3: Kata kamano, nitie chenro mar loko wachno.
about.storyP4: Watye ka yubo kit me cwako tam mo keken ma kitiyo kwede i polo kun luwiny matir adada. Pe watamo ni gin jo mukene gitimo kumeno.
about.why1: Ng'eyo weche e yo machuok  ok ong'ere kokalo kuom joma chiwo rieko
about.why2: Nonro ma itimo e yo mochanore mamiyo ng'ato oketo pache duto
about.why3: Kony ma dhi nyime kowuok e kampen kokalo kuom sirkal
about.visionText: Jotelo timoga yiero kaluwore gi rieko ma gin-go, to ok kuom hawi.
about.p1Desc: Ne ogere ne dho Swahili kod Sheng chakre chieng' mokwongo. Ok gin ranyisi mag Kisungu mane olosi e East Africa.
about.p2Title: Ng'ato ka ng'at ma ok ong'eyo weche mopondo
about.p2Desc: Weche mag joma ne oyiero ok ilando. Kampen moro ka moro neno mana weche ma ging'eyo giwegi.
about.p3Title: Ng'ato ka ng'ato nigi ratiro mar yudo gik moyangore
about.p3Desc: Chulo nengo ne olos mondo ng'at ma dwaro bedo MCA e kinde mokwongo oyud gik machalre gi kampen mar gavana.
about.p4Title: Ng'eyo weche e yo makare moloyo ng'iyo piyo

bios.morris: Tiyo gi fweny kod dongruok mar Kampeni. Gero chenro mokwongo mag weche siasa e piny Kenya mondo okel lokruok kuom kaka jotelo kawo paro.
bios.barak: Loso chenro mag intanet ma loko weche mawuok Kenya mondo obed gik mipuonjo e kampen. Ne gisechako gero sirkal mar data ne jo East Africa fintechs.
bios.albert: Chenro mar loso chenro maduong' - chakre tiyo gi data kod ranyisi mag NLP nyaka dashboard ma kampen otenoree gokinyi ka okiny.
bios.john: Ng'iyo chenro mar pesa ma Kampeni nigo kendo neno ni platformno dhi maber e weche siasa duto mag Kenya.
bios.anwar: Loso chenro mag siasa kod tudruok gi jo ohala e piny Kenya duto. Tiyo mondo oketh pogruok mantie e kind data mar weche midhiero ng'ado bura kod yiero ma itimo kuom kampenno.
